//: Copy this file to site.config.json (gitignored) and fill in this year's real values. Nothing in this file should ever contain a real guest's data — only event copy, theming, and feature toggles. Every value here can also be supplied via environment variables instead (see src/lib/config/index.ts) for hosts where committing a local file isn't convenient.

event.name: Thriller Night
event.//contactEmail: Shown on /privacy for guest data questions. REPLACE with a real inbox before sharing the site link.

//auth: WebAuthn passkey relying-party settings. Leave rpId blank and origins empty to derive both from each request's own host, which works unchanged in local dev and on Vercel. Set them explicitly to pin the deployment: rpId is the bare domain (no scheme/port), origins are full scheme+host+port URLs. Both can also come from SITE_PASSKEY_RP_ID / SITE_PASSKEY_ORIGINS (comma-separated) instead. Turning the flow on is a separate runtime switch — the Passkey Login toggle on the admin dashboard.
